verdict.rationale: Salv documents customer screening at onboarding, automatic re-screening, and on-demand screening via API. It also exposes person risk factors and monitors counterparties, so a customer linked to a suspicious counterparty surfaces, and cases display across every linked customer and counterparty. That gives some association context, but nothing explicitly addresses business or legal entities or ownership structures. Missing for 10: explicit business-entity (KYB) screening, beneficial-ownership/UBO or shareholder linkage, related-party network views, independent corroboration.
